articles.title: Skip the DRAM Tier: MoRI UMBP Runs the Agentic KV Cache on NVMe
articles.summary: Most of the traffic in agentic serving is multi-turn sessions that resend long prefixes. In the AgentX benchmark replaying real Claude Code sessions, the median turn is 142K input tokens, and over 96% of those tokens are a prefix the server has already seen [3] . A KV cache hit means the prefill node only has to process the small delta. A miss forces a full recomputation of the prefix, which burns GPU time and delays the first token.
